authorityNote: Machine-readable governance config read by scripts/validators/environment-validator.mjs through secret-scan-core.mjs. It outranks nothing; the Constitution chain governs.
purpose: Reviewed exceptions to the R-21 secret scan (APPID-P2, 2026-09-24). Each entry binds ONE value (by SHA-256, never stored) in ONE file. There is no prefix, directory or file-type exemption. An entry whose value leaves its file fails the validator until it is removed. Classifications: public-client-identifier, public-sample-key, labelled-local-fixture. A privileged secret is never an exception: it is removed and rotated.

exceptions.justification: Google Maps Platform key loaded by the Marketplace app's Android manifest (com.google.android.geo.API_KEY), so every client necessarily holds it. It is not a Firebase key, and Google's guidance is a separate key with application and API restrictions. UNKNOWN_LIVE_STATE: those restrictions are not verifiable from the repository; confirming them is a listed external action.
exceptions.evidence: Firebase API-key guidance (same page): 'If you use a Google Cloud API ... that's not for a Firebase service / product, we strongly recommend creating separate, restricted API keys.' The same value also appeared in the app's now-deleted, unreferenced Flutter-web build target (apps/marketplace/mobile/web/index.html; removed by agrimate-branding-cleanup, 2026-09-26), whose own exception entry retired with it.
exceptions.retire_when: The key is rotated, or maps loading moves behind a server-side proxy; remove this entry then.

exceptions.justification: The letbuy-y Firebase Android client key (the same value as the Marketplace app's google-services.json, SHA-256 equal), quoted in a journal's evidence excerpt of the retired admin_app's firebase_options.dart. A public client identifier per Firebase's key model; its restriction state is the same external action as the app's copy.
exceptions.evidence: Firebase, 'Learn about using and managing API keys for Firebase' (https://firebase.google.com/docs/projects/api-keys, updated 2026-09-17): keys restricted to Firebase services need not be treated as secrets; docs/migration/repository_consolidation/00c_credential_exposure_and_rotation.md, 'NOT exposures'.
exceptions.retire_when: The letbuy-y project is deleted (FB-5) or the excerpt is redacted.
